title: FAA's Advanced Air Mobility Pilot Program Takes Flight
summary: Beta Technologies and partner United Therapeutics used two Alia CX300 eCTOL aircraft to transport a manufactured heart on a roughly 275-mi. mission from Virginia to Maryland.
